Subject: Welcome to HitKeep

Welcome to HitKeep
==================

Your Acme Analytics workspace is receiving traffic from shop.example. The setup is working.

Open dashboard: https://app.hitkeep.example/dashboard

The documentation has setup, reporting, and privacy guides when you want to go deeper.
Read the docs: https://hitkeep.com/docs/

Running WordPress? The first-party plugin installs HitKeep without editing a theme.
WordPress plugin: https://wordpress.org/plugins/hitkeep/

Send feedback when something feels rough; it helps us improve the product.
Send feedback: mailto:feedback@hitkeep.com

--

HitKeep is fully open source — including every paid feature. Paid plans fund hosting and ongoing development.
Prefer to support us another way? Sponsor the open-source development: https://github.com/sponsors/pascalebeier
Or simply spread the word — it helps more than you think.
